## Проблема и результат

Опишите concrete scenario и resulting behavior.

## Проверка

- Укажите local/DB/contract checks и exact source/Base evidence.
- Для UI: served target/build identity, live states/viewport и screenshots.
- Для model/finance: actual provider/attempt/usage/charge confidence и unknown cases.
- Назовите каждый skipped/blocked gate; документация не runtime proof.

## Границы

Подтвердите owner/schema/contract compatibility, absence of unrelated dirty changes,
secrets/private payloads и недопустимого implicit retry/fallback.
